ConflictJson.description: One conflicted path in `--json` operation output.

RevertCommitEntry.description: One revert commit created on the current branch.

change_id.description: Stored `change-id` on the revert commit, or JSON `null` when absent.

oid.description: New revert commit on the current branch (full hex oid).

source.description: Source commit that was reverted (full hex oid).

subject.description: Subject line of the revert commit.

oneOf.description: Every requested step finished (or `--dry-run` printed the plan).
Every step would apply cleanly (`grit revert --check` only).
The sequence stopped on merge conflicts.
A step would be empty and `--empty stop` halted the sequence.

change_id.description: `change-id` on the last revert commit, when `result` is `completed`.

check.description: True when this outcome is from `grit revert --check` (nothing was reverted).

commits.description: Revert commits created in this invocation (newest first).

dropped.description: Source commits skipped as empty per `--empty drop`.

dry_run.description: True when `--dry-run` was set (no refs or objects were updated).

next_steps.description: Suggested follow-up commands when `result` is `conflicts` or `empty`.

oid.description: The last revert commit created (full hex), when `result` is `completed`.

source.description: The last source commit reverted in this invocation (full hex), when `result` is `completed`.

subject.description: Subject of the last revert commit, when `result` is `completed`.
